test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.

Snow __________ lightly as everyone was leaving church.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence **requires a verb** in the past continuous tense to describe an ongoing action at the time in the past when everyone was leaving the church.
 
• **"was falling" **fits this requirement, making the sentence "Snow was falling lightly as everyone was leaving church."

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is: *'**Snow** was falling** lightly as everyone was leaving church.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 **"falling"** is incorrect because it needs a helping verb.
 
• Option 2 **"is falling"** is in the present continuous tense, which is not suitable here.
 
• Option 4** "fallen"** is a past participle and does not fit the context.
